name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
oracle_text: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control. It's a Forest land. (It has no other types or abilities.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control. It's a Forest land.

needs.what: return the dying card from the graveyard to the battlefield face down under its owner's control, with the face-down characteristics overridden to a Forest land (type Land, subtype Forest, no name, no mana cost, colorless, no other types or abilities, so it taps for {G} via the Forest's intrinsic mana ability) rather than the usual face-down 2/2 creature; e.g. a `face_down: {"types": ["Land"], "subtypes": ["Forest"]}` option on return_from_graveyard / put_onto_battlefield, with the card revealed if it leaves the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: return_from_graveyard and put_onto_battlefield have no face_down option (face_down exists only on look_at_top/reveal_until/search_library, meaning private exile); manifest only takes library cards and makes a 2/2 creature; returning it face up then `animate` with exact types Land/Forest would keep its name, mana cost, colors and mana value and so is a different card
